description: Add ability to log multiple fish under 1 pound as a group as opposed to a separte entry for each

Need to change the weight for each fish to pounds and oz instead of decimal weights.  Ideally this is still one entry field with the format "xx - xx". with the dash prepopulated.  This should just be a manual entry field with no +/- buttons.  Also for both the pound and oz input, it should be a direct overwrite of that field with no backspacing required.
